data.title: Chinese Israel envoy rejects claims Beijing provides military assistance to Iran | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: "If some people believe they have evidence that China is transporting lethal weapons to Iran, which would pose a serious threat to Israel's security, I think the Israeli government will let us know."
